rules: Attempting to read or write hgatp while executing in HS-mode raises an illegal-instruction exception if mstatus .TVM is set to 1.
Fields VTSR, VTW, and VTVM in hstatus affect execution only in VS-mode and cause virtual-instruction exceptions instead of illegal-instruction exceptions.
When V=1, modifying the floating-point state (vsstatus .FS or HS-level sstatus .FS) causes both fields to be set to 3 (Dirty).
When V=1, modifying the vector state (vsstatus .VS or HS-level sstatus .VS) causes both fields to be set to 3 (Dirty).
When V=1, attempting to read or write a VS CSR directly by its own separate CSR address causes a virtual-instruction exception.
